theme: Dark Mode (Swiss Brutalist mixed with Luxury Archetype)

weights.headings: Light (300) to Black (900) for high contrast and impact

typography.rules: H1 up to text-6xl with tracking-tighter. Never center-align headings blindly; use optical alignment. Strict hierarchy gap rules.

visual_enhancers: Subtle grain texture overlay across the body for tactile luxury.
Glassmorphism for floating elements: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10.
1px crisp borders for structured grid layouts (border-white/10) to create a technical, rigorous aesthetic.
Generous padding (p-12, p-16) to provide breathing room, especially in the marketing sections.

marketing.Hero: Kinetic typography with Framer Motion masked line-by-line reveal on load. Background features subtle parallax. Huge heading, left-aligned.
marketing.Marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow, editorial ribbon. Pale text on dark background, wide tracking.
marketing.Workflow: Visual, phased flow from Idea → PRD → Prompt → Frontend → Backend → Integration. Use horizontal scrolling or grid layout.
marketing.Features: Bento Grid protocol (Tetris mode). Mix col-span-4 and col-span-8, gap-8.
marketing.Pricing: High-contrast cards. The popular tier uses 'Tracing Beam' glow or subtle 1px accent border.
marketing.Testimonials: Minimal cards with avatar, name, and quote. Left-aligned text.

saas_dashboard.Sidebar: Fixed left navigation. Minimalist icons with text. Flat aesthetic.
saas_dashboard.Project_List: Cardless grid layout or dense minimalist cards with 1px borders.
saas_dashboard.Wizard_Form: Multi-step 'Create Project' wizard. Clear progress indicators. Use modern input fields.
saas_dashboard.PRD_Viewer: Markdown viewer with sticky table of contents/section navigation on the right side.
saas_dashboard.Prompt_Viewer: Code block container with syntax highlighting and a floating 'Copy' button.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6)

layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing asymmetry. Use structured components for the SaaS dashboard.

motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion 'whileInView' with opacity and y translate.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover scale (1.02) on cards, button arrow translate-x-1 on hover. Active states on buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Text on accent buttons must be pure white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

image_urls.description: Professional woman in white crew neck shirt smiling
Blue background with lines and dots
Sleek black laptop on a white desk in a minimalist setup

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required packages: npm install framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee sonner lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge (or use yarn equivalent).
Implement a language toggle context for ID/EN bilingual content.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header. Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 border-b border-white/10'.
Hero Section: Implement Framer Motion line-by-line staggered reveal on text elements.
Workflow Visualization: Represent Idea → PRD → Prompt → Frontend → Backend → Integration clearly.
Testimonials: Use the provided professional portrait image URLs.
Apply 'data-testid' to EVERY button, link, and form input.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
